title: Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Data Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (DEAI)
institution: DEAI Erasmus Mundus consortium (coordinated at Université libre de Bruxelles)
about: Applications for the 2027-2029 cohort of DEAI, an Erasmus Mundus joint master's in Data Engineering and Artificial Intelligence, are open. The Erasmus+ scholarship period closes January 11th, 2027 (12:00 GMT); a self-funded track opens in March.
requirements: Erasmus+ scholarship track deadline: January 11th, 2027 (12:00 GMT); reference letters by January 18th, 2027
Self-funded and partial-grant track opens March 1st, 2027 (non-EU deadline May 15, EU deadline May 30, 2027)

upskill.name: Big Data Engineering & Processing I
why: field "Data engineering" → objective "Orchestrate repeatable data pipelines with tools such as Airflow, Prefect, and Dagster to coordinate ingestion, transformation, analysis, and downstream processing."
field "Data engineering" → objective "Understand distributed data processing with Hadoop MapReduce, Apache Spark, and Flink for analytical workloads that exceed the capacity of a single machine."
